name: Research starter
description: Profile preset, grocery skill, Open-Meteo weather tool, and active-inference lens rows in one plugin.

skills.name: Grocery list
skills.description: Build a shared grocery list across the discussion.
skills.content:
When the user mentions food, ingredients, or shopping:
  1. Maintain a single bullet list under the heading "Grocery list".
  2. Group items by store section (Produce, Dairy, Pantry, Frozen, Other).
  3. Mark items the user has bought with a leading [x]. Keep them in the list.
  4. When asked, summarize totals (e.g. "6 items remaining, 2 done").

Never invent items the user didn't ask for. If unsure, ask before adding.

endpoint_tools.name: get_hourly_forecast
endpoint_tools.description: Return the next 24h forecast (temperature, precipitation, wind) for a given latitude and longitude.

lens_tools.call_when: User invokes Friston / active inference / free energy framings.
lens_tools.query_template: Discuss the topic in terms of variational free-energy minimization vs Bayesian brain accounts.

lens_tools.call_when: An FEP-style claim needs to be made testable.
lens_tools.role: Translate the claim into a falsifiable prediction with a measurable signal.

lens_tools.call_when: An agent loop reports prediction error.
lens_tools.pass_criterion: Mean absolute prediction error stays below the calibrated baseline for the last N steps.

lens_tools.call_when: User mentions arousal, stress, or autonomic signals.
lens_tools.primary_role: Interoceptive arousal proxy for affective state estimation.

model.name: gpt-4o
model.system_prompt: You are a research assistant. Cite sources, prefer primary literature, flag uncertainty, and never fabricate data. Use tools when math, freshness, or external data is involved.
